content.user_title: Build Auditable Labor-Hour and T&M IGCEs
content.value_statement: Federal buyers need transparent LH and T&M estimates that separate labor, travel, materials, and ceilings. This skill builds validated workbooks from documented assumptions and government benchmarks.
actual_capabilities: Maps approved labor categories to SOC codes and BLS wage percentiles.
Builds low, mid, and high labor-cost scenarios with explicit burden multipliers.
Positions burdened labor rates against CALC+ percentiles and sample sizes.
Calculates travel from GSA Per Diem data when travel is in scope.
Separates T&M materials from labor and applies supported material-handling costs.
Creates and validates seven-sheet xlsx workbooks with independent recomputation.
limitations: Requires BLS OEWS, GSA CALC+, and GSA Per Diem MCP services for complete sourced estimates.
Does not make fair-and-reasonable determinations or create T&M or LH Determination and Findings.
Does not support FFP, cost-reimbursement, grants, or cooperative agreements.
Cannot verify spreadsheet formula execution without Excel, LibreOffice, or another compatible engine.

use_cases.title: Prepare an LH acquisition estimate
use_cases.description: Build labor scenarios, ceiling-hour comparisons, and source records for a structured Labor-Hour requirement.

use_cases.title: Estimate a T&M requirement
use_cases.description: Separate labor, travel, direct materials, and supported handling costs across base and option periods.

use_cases.title: Review proposed labor rates
use_cases.description: Compare proposed rates with BLS and CALC+ benchmarks using neutral statistics and documented sample sizes.

prompt_templates.title: Build a basic LH estimate
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Labor-Hour IGCE for [requirement] using [location], [labor categories], [FTE], [periods], [productive hours], and [burden basis].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when contract type and staffing inputs are already defined.

prompt_templates.title: Build a T&M estimate
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a T&M IGCE with [labor inputs], [travel], and [materials]. Show each cost stream separately and document all escalation assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when reimbursable materials or travel are part of the contemplated contract.

prompt_templates.title: Estimate from raw requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Decompose this requirement into labor disciplines and candidate SOC mappings: [requirements]. Ask for Stage A confirmation before collecting the remaining estimate inputs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when staffing has not been structured or approved.

prompt_templates.title: Position proposed rates
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these proposed LH or T&M rates with BLS and CALC+ data: [rates]. Provide neutral positioning only and preserve my supplied conclusion verbatim.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced rate analysis without delegating the Contracting Officer's determination.

output_examples.input: Build a three-year LH estimate for five cybersecurity analysts in Washington, DC.
output_examples.output: A seven-sheet workbook presents wage sources, burden scenarios, period totals, category ceiling hours, CALC+ comparisons, assumptions, and validation results.

output_examples.input: Estimate a T&M support requirement with labor, travel, and cloud-hosting materials.
output_examples.output: The estimate separates burdened labor from travel and materials, applies independent escalation, records source dates, and identifies any unsupported handling cost.

output_examples.input: Check whether proposed engineering rates are reasonable.
output_examples.output: The response first offers neutral positioning or a draft using the user's conclusion, then reports BLS and CALC+ comparisons without making a determination.

best_practices: Confirm LH or T&M before calculations and keep materials outside LH labor pricing.
Provide productive hours, ceiling hours, period dates, location, and the burden basis.
Review every source, assumption, formula-validation result, and disclosed data fallback.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the estimate total as the binding contract ceiling without confirmation.
Do not apply labor burden or arbitrary profit percentages to T&M materials.
Do not ask the skill to make legal, contract-type, or fair-and-reasonable determinations.

faq.question: What contract types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Labor-Hour and Time-and-Materials estimates. It does not support FFP or cost-reimbursement estimates.

faq.question: Which data sources does it use?
faq.answer: It uses BLS OEWS wages, GSA CALC+ ceiling rates, and GSA Per Diem data when applicable.

faq.question: Can it choose between LH and T&M?
faq.answer: No. The user must select the contemplated contract type after reviewing the structural difference.

faq.question: Can it determine that proposed rates are fair and reasonable?
faq.answer: No. It provides neutral benchmark positioning or formats a draft from the Contracting Officer's supplied conclusion.

faq.question: How are T&M materials handled?
faq.answer: Materials remain separate from labor. Handling indirects require a user-supplied accounting or solicitation basis.

faq.question: How is the workbook validated?
faq.answer: The bundled validator audits structure and independently recomputes totals. LibreOffice can also execute formulas and verify cached values.
